name: AsoBeast
description: App Store and Google Play keyword rank tracker and ASO tool.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (postgres/), the job queues (redis/) and the secret keys (state/). Back up the whole folder: without state/secrets.env, connected store credentials can't be read.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: AsoBeast web app and API, published on host as 6700

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you open AsoBeast at, like http://192.168.1.20:6700 or https://aso.example.com. AsoBeast works from any address; this one is used for links in emails and alerts. With https, the sign-in cookie is marked secure.
